segments.text: Eleven gifts she'll actually love. All under sixty dollars. And the one catch to know before you buy each one.
Quick note: our links are affiliate links. It never changes our picks. Prices move daily, so always check the link.

segments.name: Fuzzy faux-fur slippers
segments.text: Number one. Fuzzy faux-fur slippers, about sixteen dollars. They're on almost every winter gift list, and they're safe when you don't know her taste. The catch? Sizes come in pairs. If she's between sizes, go up.
tags: Safe if you don't know her taste
segments.catch: Sizes come in pairs. Between sizes? Go up.

segments.name: Candle warmer lamp
segments.text: Number two. A candle warmer lamp, about twenty dollars. It melts the candle from the top, so there's no open flame. The catch? You still need the candle, so check the jar fits under the lamp.
segments.catch: Candle not included. Check the jar fits.

segments.name: P.F. Candle Co. Spruce
segments.text: Three. The P.F. Candle Co. Spruce candle, about twenty-four dollars. A winter-forest scent, in a jar that looks good on any shelf. The catch? Scent is personal. Not sure? Go fresh or citrus.
segments.catch: Scent is personal. Unsure? Go fresh or citrus.

segments.text: Still coming: a plant she can't kill, and a luxury brand at a gift price.
Twenty-five to forty. The sweet spot.
segments.label: $25 to $40

segments.name: Hommey silk eye mask
segments.text: Four. The Hommey silk eye mask, about twenty-seven dollars. Mulberry silk for flights, naps, and lazy Sunday mornings. The catch? Hand wash only.

segments.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz
segments.text: Five. The Owala FreeSip forty-ounce tumbler, about thirty-five dollars. Built-in straw, side handle, and it goes everywhere with her. The catch? Forty ounces won't fit every cup holder. For a commuter, get the twenty-four.
segments.catch: 40 oz won't fit every cup holder. Commuter? Get the 24 oz.

segments.name: Summer Fridays Jet Lag Essentials
segments.text: Six. Summer Fridays Jet Lag Essentials, about thirty-four dollars. The brand's favorites in travel sizes, in one carry-on pouch. The catch? Minis run out fast. It's a treat, not a stock-up.
segments.catch: Minis run out fast. A treat, not a stock-up.

segments.name: Salt & Stone body wash
segments.text: Seven. Salt and Stone body wash, Bergamot and Hinoki, about thirty-six dollars. A clean, woody scent, in a bottle worth showing off. The catch? It's a lot for body wash. Which is exactly why she won't buy it for herself.
segments.catch: Pricey for body wash. That's why she won't buy it herself.

segments.name: Gold cuff bracelet
segments.text: Eight. A gold cuff bracelet, twenty to forty dollars. Chunky gold cuffs are one of Pinterest's predicted looks for twenty twenty-six. The catch? At this price it's gold-plated, so keep it away from water.
segments.catch: Gold-plated at this price. Keep it away from water.

segments.name: LEGO Botanicals Tiny Plants
segments.text: Nine. LEGO Botanicals Tiny Plants, about forty dollars. Nine little plants to build. A calm evening, and a plant she can't kill. The catch? It takes a few hours, so it suits someone who likes a project.
segments.catch: Takes a few hours. Best for someone who likes a project.

segments.text: Forty to sixty. When it has to feel like a proper present.
segments.label: $40 to $60

segments.name: Bala Bangles, 1 lb pair
segments.text: Ten. Bala Bangles, the one-pound pair, fifty-five dollars. Weights that look like jewelry, for walks and home workouts. The catch? We haven't seen them discounted, so fifty-five is the usual price.
segments.catch: Rarely discounted. $55 is the usual price.

segments.name: Charlotte Tilbury mini set
segments.text: And eleven. The Charlotte Tilbury mini beauty set, about fifty-four dollars. A luxury beauty brand, at a gift price. The catch? Holiday sets change every year, so check what's inside.
segments.catch: Sets change yearly. Check what's inside.

segments.text: If you only buy one: the LEGO plants for a surprise, the Owala for every day, or the slippers under twenty-five.
Every pick is linked in the description and the pinned comment, with the full guide for the US and the UK. Happy gifting.
